rules: CATIA is always authoritative for engineering knowledge.
The temporary shadow model may supplement CATIA only when required information is unavailable in CATIA.
Committed repository content is authoritative for implementation state.
Local uncommitted changes are not authoritative implementation state.
Every persisted Source shall be assigned to exactly one Project.
Project identity and Source identity shall remain separate.
Framework assignments shall reference valid mapping-target node IDs.
Unknown framework or ontology reference IDs shall be rejected.
Context-only Sources shall not create engineering evidence.
Consensus, confidence and variance shall not authorize publication or promotion.
Every publication, promotion or authoritative selection target shall require an exact Human Review Decision.
Required LLM context shall never be silently truncated.
External ontology systems are references and shall not override project engineering authority.
Implementation evidence shall not silently create normative requirements.
The first Architecture-to-Requirements Reconciliation was completed during the Post-Phase-P Reconciliation Gate.
Phase N shall perform final reconciliation after Phases G through L.
Published P9 run artifacts are processing evidence, not Approved Input.
A P9 run ending in awaiting_review requests Human Review but does not approve engineering knowledge.
Only eligible, exactly reviewed and fingerprint-bound evidence may become Approved Input.
Phase G shall not generate model candidates or SysML v2.
Relationship prioritization shall remain advisory until Human Review.
Distinct relationship semantics shall not be silently collapsed into a generic link.
Model comparability shall be assessed against a versioned profile.
Task-profile portability shall be evaluated using measured implementation evidence.
Project Affinity Recommendation shall remain advisory and low priority.
The executable prototype target is 2026-08-14.
Schedule pressure shall not weaken Human Review, traceability, project isolation, validation or publication gates.
After every SSOT UPDATE, repository synchronization shall be committed, pushed and verified.

recorded_candidates.affected_model_area: Human Review Workspace and Finalized Review Artifacts
recorded_candidates.engineering_rationale: A finalized Review result is valid only as the exact immutable set of reviewed_document.json, effective_decisions.json and reviewed_report.md. Mixed, incomplete, additional or fingerprint-inconsistent artifacts shall not form a valid finalized Review result.
known_relationships: Provides the exact integrity boundary consumed by G5 promotion.
Binds one finalized Review Version and one exact Review Revision.

recorded_candidates.affected_model_area: Finalized Review Persistence Loading Scanning and Recovery
recorded_candidates.engineering_rationale: A finalized artifact set shall become visible only through validated atomic publication. Interrupted, unsafe, incomplete or altered states shall fail closed and require recovery instead of being treated as valid evidence.
implementation_evidence: tests for finalized artifact persistence loading and scanning
known_relationships: Protects the G5 promotion eligibility boundary.

recorded_candidates.affected_model_area: Review Item Lineage across Review Document Versions
recorded_candidates.engineering_rationale: A Review Item copied into a reopened successor version requires explicit one-to-one lineage to exactly one predecessor Review Item while preserving its stable subject key. The relation is distinct from split, merge and original creation.
known_relationships: Exactly one derived_from_review_item_ids entry is required.
The stable subject key remains unchanged.

recorded_candidates.engineering_rationale: Only the latest finalized Review Version may be reopened. Reopening creates one new successor Draft, preserves the finalized predecessor and prohibits parallel successor branches or reopening when a later version exists.
implementation_evidence: tests for Review reopening and lifecycle integration
known_relationships: Defines predecessor and successor version lineage.

recorded_candidates.engineering_rationale: Approved Input manifests remain immutable; current authority is derived from the immutable manifest plus append-only lifecycle events.
Promotion Equivalence uses stable subject identity plus authority-relevant content and evidence so materially unchanged accepted successor subjects retain the existing active Approved Input.
known_relationships: Preserves stable authority across reopened Review Versions.
